facts: Taxonomy and Concept: business vocabulary separate from governance dataClass
ConceptRevision: immutable definition, taxonomy/ordinal snapshot and historical parentMeaning
ConceptDisposition: unique terminal retirement or forward-ordinal supersession
ConceptAlias: taxonomy-scoped normalized alias to exact meaning
ClassificationSet, ClassificationAssignment and ClassificationRetraction: typed sidecar and retained correction history
operations: Classification.status and resolveAssignment through authorized Engine reads
invariants: Same-taxonomy hierarchy has kernel commit-time cycle prevention
Assignments and aliases pin immutable meaning, never a floating latest concept
Supersession targets exact meaning in same taxonomy with higher immutable ordinal; cycles cannot form
Revision taxonomy/ordinal snapshots are checked against immutable concept fields; parentMeaning pins historical context
Historical assignment recording remains legal after retirement; no current eligibility claim is inferred
IdentifierSet owns external codes; no generic subject reference or governance authorization is introduced

acceptance.description: fixtures for knowledge, products, risk and job-family classification
